{{Top|leg}}
The '''B'Ya Weapons Testing Facility''' served as the testing site for the prototype [[Fusion Accelerator Cannon]] sometime before [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. [[Technician/Legends|Chief Weapon Tech]] [[Yan Dom Guez]] worked at the facility and [[Holorecorder/Legends|recorded]] the last test of the [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]]. It was during this test that the prototype Fusion Accelerator Cannon destroyed the Testing Facility and killed Guez. The recording and the cannon would later be salvaged from the facility's ruins.
